title: Deepfake scams in practice
intro: A familiar voice is not proof. Decide what you would do in each moment from this module's lessons.

decisions.title: Call from Unknown number

artifact.name: Unknown number
body: Hello, it's me, Narmin! There was an accident and the police are holding me. I need 900 manat now, don't tell the family!

decisions.explain: A cloned voice will not know the word you agreed on.

decisions.title: Message from Aynur Guliyeva (new account)
decisions.prompt: What do you do with this message?

artifact.name: Aynur Guliyeva (new account)
body: Hi! My old account was closed, this is my new one.
I am video calling you now, I urgently need a document.

options.label: I will call your old number first

decisions.explain: The new account story is meant to stop you from checking.

decisions.title: News page with a presenter video
decisions.prompt: The video on this page talks just like the TV presenter. What do you do?

artifact.title: Presenter reveals the secret on air: 3000 a month
body: Video: the presenter explains how anyone can earn 3,000 manat a month with NeftInvest.
Places are limited. Sign up today.

options.label: Watch the video and sign up

decisions.explain: A big profit promise and a fake domain are enough.

decisions.title: Team meeting tomorrow at 10:00
decisions.prompt: Is this request normal or dangerous?

artifact.subject: Team meeting tomorrow at 10:00
body: The meeting link is in the internal calendar. No agenda attached, just note the time.

decisions.explain: A normal meeting invite: the agency's domain and nothing is asked.

decisions.title: Message from Tural (relative)
decisions.prompt: Is this request normal or dangerous?

artifact.name: Tural (relative)
body: You saw me on video, it's me. Tell me the code your card just got, it's for a ticket.

decisions.explain: Nobody, not even a relative, should ask for your card code. Video is not proof.
